user.title: Configure CircuitSetup Energy Analyzer
user.description:
Select CircuitSetup energy source sensors and define monitored circuits.

{mapping_suggestions}

error.no_source_entities: Select at least one source sensor.
error.invalid_source_entities: Source sensor entity IDs must be text values.
error.invalid_circuits: Circuit definitions must be a list.
error.invalid_mains_source_entities: Mains NILM source entity IDs must be text values.
error.invalid_known_load_circuits: Known directly monitored circuits must be text values.

init.title: CircuitSetup Energy Analyzer options
init.description:
Tune diagnostics and experimental NILM settings.

{mapping_suggestions}

missing_required_sensor.title: Energy Analyzer source sensor is missing
missing_required_sensor.description: A configured circuit is missing a required source sensor. Reconfigure the circuit mapping before appliance analysis can continue.

phase_mismatch.title: Energy Analyzer phase pairing looks suspicious
phase_mismatch.description: A dual-phase circuit has source data that does not look like a valid paired load. Review the selected channels and CT orientation.

stale_source_sensor.title: Energy Analyzer source sensor is stale
stale_source_sensor.description: A configured source sensor has not updated recently. Appliance analysis is paused for the affected circuit.

missing_mains_nilm_sensor.title: Energy Analyzer mains NILM sensor is missing
missing_mains_nilm_sensor.description: Experimental NILM is enabled but a configured mains source sensor is missing or unavailable. Per-circuit analysis can continue, but NILM discovery is paused.

low_nilm_confidence.title: Energy Analyzer NILM confidence is low
low_nilm_confidence.description: Experimental NILM is seeing too many overlapping aggregate events for confident signature discovery. The integration will keep these as observations instead of sending appliance notifications.
